en.body:
I built a runnable CDC path for that gap: PostgreSQL WAL → Debezium → Kafka → Python normalize → dbt bronze/silver/gold, with a Streamlit layer on top.

The stake is not “real-time for the slide.” It is latency and recovery when analytics lags the operational system of record.
